pr_title: roachprod: handle insecure cluster in delete cluster config
pr_body:
If a insecure cluster is created, the corresponding config is created in prometheus. This config is created in a separate location that is different from the secure clusters. When this cluster is destroyed, the ?insecure=true flag has to be passed so that the specific config file gets deleted. This is not done today.

This change passes the ?insecure=true for insecure clusters

Fixes: #125616
Epic: None
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/125618)

> Is there a reason why when we create a cluster config, we note `insecure` as part of the HTTP request body, but when we delete it, we have to append it as part of the url? Is it an anti pattern to send a body for DELETE?
> 
> Besides that it lgtm!

DELETE does not take any body. Also, this is a general convention.

issue_context.title: roachprod: The insecure flag is not considered when deleting a cluster
issue_context.body:
If a insecure cluster is created, the corresponding config is created in prometheus. This config is created in a separate location that is different from the secure clusters. When this cluster is destroyed, the `?insecure=true` flag has to be passed so that the specific config file is deleted. This is not done today.

To reproduce, create and start a insecure cluster and then destroy the same. The targets remain in 
https://grafana.testeng.crdb.io/prometheus/targets?search=&scrapePool=cluster-configs-insecure

Jira issue: CRDB-39528
